title: New Austin Leaders: Nofziger Sworn, Trevino Elected
summary:
*   Three new members, including Michael "Max" Nofziger, were officially sworn in to begin their terms.
*   John Trevino Jr. was unanimously re-elected to serve as Mayor Pro Tem.
*   This special meeting was dedicated solely to these official leadership and membership changes.

Memorandum To:
Mayor Cooksey called to order the meeting of the Council* noting the presence of all
Councilmembers. The purpose of the meeting was for the swearing in ceremonies for the
newly elected members of the City Council (Oath of Office); and election of Mayor Pro
Tern. The newly elected members of the City Council are Sally Shipman, Place 3; George
Humphrey •• Place 4; and Michael "Max" Nofziger, Place 1.
ELECTION OF MAYOR PRO TEM
The Council, on Councilmember Humphrey's motion, Councilmember Carl-Mitchell's second,
approved John Trevino
Jr. as Mayor Pro Tern. (7-0 Vote)
